item.title: Comment: Strike against Iran seems like 2003; in some ways, worse
item.description: George W. Bush at least got authorization from Congress. Trump hasn’t bothered. And the GOP is fine with it.

item.title: Comment: Decades of presidents ignored Congress, War Powers Act
item.description: Trump is little different than many since Nixon. Still, Congress should vote on authorization for war.

item.title: Letter: Legislature’s ‘Flock camera’ bill won’t protect data privacy
item.description: Flock cameras are up against the ropes in Washington state. And the only thing that can save them is Senate Bill 6002in the Legislature.

item.title: Letter: Millionaires’ tax should go to state voters
item.description: I want to raise my voice against Washington state implementing a so-called “millionaires ‘tax,” an unconstitutional income tax, by any other name.

item.title: Editorial: Keep up efforts to fund new downtown stadium
